FAQ

Questions

DO PRICES INCLUDE EVERYTHING?

Listed prices are starting points — final pricing depends on size, detail and placement, confirmed after review.

IS MY DATE GUARANTEED?

Your preferred date is a request. It's confirmed only once the artist approves it.

READY TO START YOUR TATTOO?

YOUR DATA

Privacy & Your Photos

WHAT WE COLLECT

Only what's needed to prepare your consultation: your contact details and the photos you choose to upload (placement area, existing tattoos, references). Nothing else is requested.

HOW YOUR PHOTOS ARE HANDLED

Photos are sent over an encrypted connection and stored privately — never on a public URL. Only your artist can view them.

HOW LONG WE KEEP THEM

Photos and request details are kept only as long as needed for your consultation and appointment, and are deleted automatically within 12 months of your visit (or sooner on request).

YOUR RIGHT TO DELETION

You can ask us to delete your information and photos at any time by contacting the studio — we'll confirm once it's done.
